_comment: Curated per-language NLP tool registrations consumed by scripts/derive-tools.mjs
(populates resources.tools[] — resource EXISTENCE only, boundary invariant kind 2).
Two sections: perLanguage lists explicit entries; fromCaches derives per-language
entries from a downloaded upstream cache in cli/data/ (fetch-from-source; the cache
is rebuilt by the named download script and is the citable evidence). Every entry
MUST carry a source string citing its basis. No measured scores here ever (lint R3).
Data-over-code (docs/AGENTS.md §1): language-specific facts live in this file,

crk.name: morphodict — intelligent dictionary platform (powers itwêwina)
crk.source: github.com/UAlbertaALTLab/morphodict (Apache-2.0; "The Language Independent Intelligent Dictionary"; production deployment itwewina.altlab.app) — verified 2026-07-19

crk.name: crk-db — Plains Cree lexical database aggregation tooling
crk.source: github.com/UAlbertaALTLab/crk-db (GPL-3.0; aggregates CW/MD/AECD sources for ALTLab's dictionary — the repo deliberately excludes the dictionary data, which lives in a private ALTLab repository) — verified 2026-07-19

entry.name: NRC g2p — grapheme-to-phoneme mapping
entry.source: NRC Canada Indigenous Languages Technology — per-language mapping directory in the g2p library (MIT; the language-support basis for NRC tools such as ReadAlong Studio); cache data/nrc-g2p-langs.json
